hits.name: Spotify
hits.description:
Access all of your favorite music, discover new songs, and share music online with your friends - all in one place.
    Create shared playlists or share individual songs with your Facebook friends with just a click of a button.
    Follow your favorite artists or friends to know what they are listening to, and then save the songs to your own playlists.
      Spotify is the best way to have access to millions of songs and all the latest hits.

hits.name: Riff
hits.description:
Riff is a Spotify client that puts your music library front and center. It features a clean, minimal design that lets you listen distraction-free.
      
        Note: Riff requires a Spotify Premium account. Some accounts may not work due to Spotify's new PlayPlay DRM, which is proprietary and cannot be implemented externally.
      
      Features:
      
        Modern GTK4 and libadwaita interface with light/dark themes and a responsive layout
        Play, pause, skip, seek, shuffle, and repeat with gapless playback
        Like tracks and follow artists, albums, and playlists
        Browse your saved albums, playlists, liked tracks, and followed artists
        Create and edit your own playlists and add tracks to them
        Search for albums, artists, tracks, and playlists
        Share and open Spotify links with your friends using automatic link detection
        Fine-tune your sound with a built-in DSP engine featuring a 10-band equalizer, stereo pan, and pitch shift
        Advanced desktop integration: media keys (MPRIS), inhibits session suspend while playing, and secure credential storage
        Keyboard shortcuts and touch gestures

hits.name: ncspot
hits.description:
ncspot is a ncurses Spotify client written in Rust using
      librespot. It is heavily inspired by ncurses MPD clients, such as ncmpc.
    
      
      A simple and resource friendly alternative to the official client,
      which also supports platforms that currently don't have a Spotify client,
      such as the *BSDs.
    
      
      Note that ncspot offers features that are legally incompatible with
      free Spotify accounts.
      You must have an existing premium Spotify subscription to use ncspot.

hits.name: verse
hits.summary: Get currently playing Spotify song lyrics
hits.description:
A simple application that fetches lyrics of the song currently
			playing on Spotify and displays it on a beautiful user interface. Features:
		
      
        Simple, easy to use interface
        Paginated view displays previously played songs
        Multiple themes

hits.name: VCMusic
hits.description:
VCMusic is a simple and lightweight music player designed for smooth music playback and easy music
            management. It is written in the Crystal programming language and uses an Adwaita-based user
            interface.
        
      Features
      
        Audio and video playback (video as audio).
        Easy playlist creation.
        Volume boost up to 1000%.
        Supports soft pause and play.
        Supports 432 Hz playback mode.
        Experimental audio visualizer.
        Supports play queue management.
        Simple and clean user interface.
        Supports opening files with VCMusic.
        Supports MPRIS controls.
        Supports background playback.
        Supports Multi-algorithm search.

hits.name: MediaHarbor
hits.description:
MediaHarbor is a cross-platform music downloader and player. It connects to Spotify,
      Tidal, Qobuz, Deezer, Apple Music, and more, letting you download
      tracks at their native source quality and play them from a local library.
    
      Features include:
      
        High-quality audio downloads from major streaming services
        Built-in player with shuffle, repeat, crossfade, and visualizer
        Lyrics display with word-level and line-level sync
        Automatic metadata tagging and cover art embedding
        Local library management with file watching

hits.name: Nuclear
hits.description:
Nuclear finds and plays music from many sources in one place. Search for any song, album, or
      artist, build playlists, and start listening, with no ads and no tracking.
      Plugins add new music sources, lyrics, and metadata providers, and themes change how the player
      looks. Nuclear also shows synced lyrics, keeps your favorites and listening history, and can be
      controlled remotely from your phone.

hits.name: Spotube
hits.summary: Plugin powered, open source music streaming client
hits.description:
A cross-platform, extensible, open source music streaming platform. Bring your own music metadata,
      playlists and audio sources with plugins made by the community or by yourself.
      
        Plugin powered: supports any platform or custom music service through plugins
        Community driven plugins for popular platforms, or create your own
        Freely downloadable tracks with tagged metadata
        Time synced lyrics regardless of plugin support
        No telemetry, diagnostics or user data collection
        Small size, low data usage and native performance

hits.name: Qobine
hits.description:
Powered by [Qobuz](https://www.qobuz.com). Requires a paid subscription. This does not allow
      you to listen for free. This application uses the Qobuz API but is not certified by Qobuz, and
      is not affiliated with Qobuz in any way.
      Qobine implements streaming reporting using Qobuz API to ensure compliance and fair artist compensation.
      Listening to your Qobuz music with Qobine: a Qobuz client designed for GNOME.
      Upon first launch, a browser spawns where you will need to login to Qobuz with your active streaming
      subscription.
      Qobine supports full Qobuz audio quality. But make sure that your pipewire configuration is
      correct.
      
        View and stream your favorite albums, artists and playlists
        Search the full Qobuz catalogue
        Add / remove favorites
        Add to queue / play next
        Create / edit / delete playlists

hits.summary: YouTube and YouTube Music in a single app
hits.description:
Manage video/music library without login
        Manage watch history without login
        No ads
        Download video
        Hide shorts
        Sponsor block

hits.name: Give Me Lyrics
hits.description: See the lyrics of the song that is playing, from any application. Sing along with the option to sync lyrics.

hits.name: Playlifin
hits.description:
A tool to convert a Youtube Music playlist to a Jellyfin playlists. You MUST have downloaded the playlist and put them on your Jellyfin before running this app.
      This program get all the song titles in your Youtube Playlist and try its best to find the same song on Jellyfin and add it in the new playlist.
      This is useful when you sort music by albums, genre or artists but still want to have your playlist after importing your music to Jellyfin.
      Recommended format to download a playlist with yt-dlp:  /usr/bin/yt-dlp -x --audio-format mp3 --prefer-ffmpeg -o '%(title)s.%(ext)s' --embed-thumbnail (YoutubeURL)
      It uses the yt-dlp backend for fetching Youtube informations and the Jellyfin API for the Jellyfin informations.

hits.name: OpenSCQ30
hits.description: Cross platform application for controlling settings of Soundcore headphones and earbuds.

hits.name: Lyrics Finder
hits.description:
MediaHuman Lyrics Finder is a free application that finds and adds missing
      lyrics to all songs in your music library. The found lyrics are automatically
      saved to files. It's a safe operation — the application will not overwrite
      the lyrics you already have.
    
      
      Very easy to use: just drag and drop some tracks from your favorite music
      player and Lyrics Finder will do the rest. The found lyrics will be saved
      automatically.
    
      
      Lyrics are collected from various sources on the Internet including
      LRCLIB, Musixmatch, AZLyrics, Bandcamp and others.
    
      Features:
      
        Batch processing of entire music folders
        Multiple lyrics providers with automatic fallback
        Synchronized lyrics (LRC) support
        Tag correction via Last.fm
        Supports MP3, FLAC, OGG, M4A, WMA and other popular formats

hits.name: SongRec
hits.description:
SongRec is an unofficial Shazam client for Linux, written in Rust. It allows you to easily recognize
      songs from your speakers, microphone or audio files.
      Features:
      - Recognize tracks from an arbitrary audio file.
      - Recognize audio from the microphone.
      - Usage from both GUI and command line.
      - Provide an history of the recognized songs on the GUI, exportable to CSV.
      - Continuous song detection from the microphone, with the ability to choose your input device.
      - Ability to recognize songs from your speakers rather than your microphone.

hits.name: Euphonica
hits.summary: Advanced music playback powered by MPD
hits.description:
Dynamic playlists, integrated spectrum visualiser, background blur, synced lyrics & more.
      
        Features
      
      
        Both a self-contained music player and an MPD-compatible client. The power of MPD, without the manual set-up. Plays nearly every format, DSD included!
        Supports most MPD features, from queue reordering and ReplayGain to output control, crossfade and MixRamp.
        Genre & tag filtering, plus in-app tag editing.
        Client-side dynamic playlists: both query and sticker filter rules, multiple ordering clauses, fetch-first limits, scheduled refreshes, all via an intuitive editor UI.
        Fetch album arts, artist avatars and (synced) song lyrics from external sources (currently supporting Last.fm, MusicBrainz, TheAudioDB and LRCLIB).
        Configurable multi-artist and multi-genre tag splitting.
        Stay in control while in the background via MPRIS & XDG Background Portal.
        Customisable spectrum visualiser (FIFO or system PipeWire).
        Live bitrate readout + audio quality indicators (lossy, lossless, hi-res, DSD).
        Largely **zero-cost** static background blur.
        Volume knob with dBFS readout support ('cuz why not?)
        User-friendly configuration UI & GSettings backend
        MPD passwords are securely stored in your user's login keyring.
        Works with large playlists (tested with 30K songs).
        Commands are bundled into lists for efficient MPD-side processing where possible.
        myMPD-compatible stickers handling.
      
      This Flatpak installation bundles MPD 0.24 internally to serve as the playback engine for Standalone Mode.
      
        PipeWire permissions
      
      Euphonica requires PipeWire capture permissions for its PipeWire visualizer backend, but currently it is only possible to specify a "blanket" PipeWire permission that also allows screen recording, microphone access, etc. Euphonica does not make use of these extra permissions, and will be updated to use a more restricted "audio portal" when one becomes available.
      
        Screenshot content copyright information & disclaimer
      
      Album arts contained in the screenshots have been substituted with random photos from Pexel. All credits go to the original authors.
      Euphonica is solely a music player programme and does not provide any media content or sources. Users must provide their own content or manually configure Euphonica to access third party online services.

hits.name: Plexamp
hits.description:
Plexamp is the answer to the question "what would happen if you gave a handful of Plex music
      and pixel nerds a few cocktails and free rein to create the app of their dreams?"
      Plexamp is a beautiful, dedicated Plex music player with tons of goodies for audiophile purists,
      music curators, and music fans of all ages looking for their next aural fix.
      SUPER AUDIO PLAYER: Loudness leveling, true gapless playback, Sweet Fades™, soft transitions,
      a configurable preamp, a 10-band EQ, and more. Perfection for golden ears, buttery smooth touches
      for the rest of us. Custom pre-caching so your music keeps playing, because sometimes life brings
      you through tunnels.
      MUSIC TO YOUR EYES: Experience your music collection like you've never seen it before, with
      our UltraBlur backgrounds, over a dozen hypnotic visualizers, and four visual themes to satisfy
      every taste.
      FIND YOUR FIX: Radios built from your library and your cooler friends' collections. Travel through
      time, pick a style or mood, or listen album-by-album like the purist you are. Use the Mix Builder
      to explore and craft your perfect blend. Explore your personal charts and see what you were into
      last Fall or your top albums from the 60s.
      OFFLINE BLISS: Grab a few hours of your favorite playlist or stations with just a few taps.
      Download a custom mix or artist radio for the plane. Simple but powerful offline support for when
      you're in the woods or run out of cellular data.
      IT'S THE LITTLE THINGS: Powerful search. Playback activity history. Swipe-up play queue peeking.
      Fun artist explorations. As many settings and tweaks as our resident UXpert let us add.
      ENTERPRISE CLASS CUSTOMER RELATIONSHIP MANAGEMENT: Just kidding. It's a music player.

The Danceinterpreter is a utility to display songs and their according dances at ballroom dance events

hits.name: Musicfetch
hits.description:
Musicfetch makes the process of downloading and tagging songs from platforms such as YouTube/Soundcloud/Bandcamp easy.
      You can search for songs, albums or playlists in app or paste a list of URLs to download them.
      Key Features:

hits.name: Chronograph
hits.summary: Sync lyrics of your loved songs
hits.description:
Chronograph is an open-source application designed for accurately syncing lyrics 
    with audio timestamps.
      You may notice that many of music players support synced lyrics which are 
    highlighted line-by-line or word-by-word while playing? This app was designed to 
    give the community an ability to be the ones who make these lyrics.
      Chronograph directly supports publishing to LRCLib. As many FOSS music players 
    use LRCLib to fetch synchronized lyrics, this integration allows users to easily 
    contribute their work back to the open-source community.
      If you have a large base of music and just want to download lyrics for all of it, 
    Chronograph also supports mass lyrics downloading. It will try to find lyrics for each 
    of your track on LRClib and save it depending on your settings.
      Syncing Modes
      
        Line-by-Line (Primary): Here, every time you do sync action, timestamp is placed 
      for the whole line of lyrics. This is the most supported format of synced lyrics.
        Word-by-Word (Advanced): Designed for true karaoke quality. It places a 
      timestamp for every single word, enabling players to animate lyrics with precision.
      
      Supported Formats
      
        OGG
        FLAC
        MP3
        M4A
        OPUS
        WAV
        AAC (reduced functionality)
